_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: The model picker (a PrimeVue Select) opens, lists models, persists the selection, and its "Manage Models" action opens the manage-models modal. The screen is the default 393x727 phone. To "open the model picker": wait for ".header" to be visible; when the window is narrower than 768px, the picker is in the overflow menu: if ".chat-overflow-popover" is not visible, click the button with aria-label exactly "More options", then click the visible ".model-picker.p-select" inside ".chat-overflow-popover"; on a wider window, click the visible ".model-picker.p-select" inside ".status-bar". The element clicked is "the picker"; its panel is ".model-picker-panel". Name elements by ARIA role and accessible name, as Playwright's getByRole does; "named X" means an exact name match. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /new and open the model picker. 2. The panel should be visible and hold at least one ".p-select-option". Its buttons named "Manage Models" and "Refresh" should be visible. 3. On a phone it is a sheet across the bottom of the screen: the panel's bounding box must have x exactly 0, width exactly window.innerWidth, and Math.round(y + height) exactly window.innerHeight. 4. In this single-source install there must be no ".model-picker-option-source" in the panel (count 0). 5. Remember the trimmed text of the first option's ".model-picker-option-name" (in a window variable), then click the first option. 6. The picker should contain that remembered name, and localStorage "shelley_selected_model" must be exactly "predictable" (the raw model id, not the label). The panel stays open: it should still be visible. 7. Click the panel's button named "Close": the panel should be hidden, and the picker's ".p-select-label" must be document.activeElement (focus is handed back to the trigger). 8. Open the model picker again; the panel should be visible. 9. Click the panel's button named "Manage Models": a visible dialog (role dialog) named "Manage Models" should appear, and the panel should be hidden.

steps.expression: (function() { var rect = document.querySelector('.model-picker-panel').getBoundingClientRect(); return rect.x === 0 && rect.width === window.innerWidth && Math.round(rect.y + rect.height) === window.innerHeight; })()

(function() { var el = document.querySelector('.model-picker-panel .p-select-option .model-picker-option-name'); window._firstModelName = el ? el.textContent.trim() : ''; return window._firstModelName ? 'remembered' : 'NO_NAME'; })()
